text: Storm delayed the order over an hour and the fries arrived cold and limp. The tracker kept saying 10 minutes away. Awful.
Rose latte, rain on the pink windows, and a corner table to myself. This cafe was made for monsoon evenings.
barish mein garam chai aur fries best combo hai, bas sabne andar ghus ke seats le li. thodi bheed zyada thi.
Sandwich box arrived dry inside a fully soaked bag in the rain. Whatever wrapping they use, it works.
Kabir was alone on the counter during the rain rush. Twelve minutes for one coffee and my cab left without me.
Thunder outside, steady wifi inside, cold brew on my corner table. Got more done here than at home all week.
Sixteen-item team order in a downpour: every filter coffee sealed, every sandwich labelled. One dented cup, forgiven.
bachon ke drinks aane mein 25 min lage, rain crowd tha itna. Taste achha tha par wait ne mood kharab kar diya.
Waited 35 minutes for an avocado toast while drenched walk-ins kept getting served first. Nobody even apologised.
cheese toast thoda thanda aaya but rain mein expected tha. Cheddar bubbly aur spicy - worth the 260 anyway.
Dev waved me toward the dry side away from the entrance without being asked. Latte refills kept me working through the storm.
v slow queue, lid went on crooked, flat white leaked all over my notes. Wet day made worse.
Warm waffle with maple while it poured outside. Crisp edges, soft middle, pink walls glowing. Perfect.
ek kulhad chai, ek cheese toast, aur baarish ka free show khidki se. 400 ke andar best evening.
Waffle came soft from trapped steam after a rainy ride. Maple was still good. Ordering again on a dry day.
Hot chocolate still steaming on arrival despite the storm. Marshmallows melted just right.
25 minutes for our order while soaked customers jammed the doorway. Kids melting down, staff nowhere. Terrible.
Croissant is 180 now. Still excellent, but when you buy one daily you notice every quiet little bump.
Ducked in from a Bengaluru downpour and found the best filter coffee of my trip. The dabarah froth was a treat.
Matcha whisked fresh as thunder rolled over Indiranagar. The rain soundtrack made it feel like a film.
Pasta and fries both arrived cold after an hour in the rain. Hungry kids were not impressed.
Cappuccino was well made but the storm turned the cafe into a packed shelter by noon. Calls were hard.
Twelve cheese toasts to the office, all correct, all still warm-ish despite the weather. Solid bulk delivery.
Queue moved slowly with everyone dripping and grumpy. Iced latte was sealed well though, no spill in my bag.
baarish mein 120 ka filter coffee beats everything. Dabarah froth dekh ke hi maza aa gaya.
Shake cup leaked through the paper bag in the rain; half of it was gone before the rider reached. Messy.
Soaked kids, quick shakes, and a wiped-down table from Zoya without us asking. Rainy evening saved.
Office lunch during the storm: sandwich came a touch cold but the paneer tikka filling was genuinely good.
order 70 min late aaya aur fries bilkul thandi. Baarish samajh aata hai, itna delay nahi.
Espresso in three minutes flat, even mid-downpour. Out the door, done.
Every plug seat taken, umbrellas dripping on every chair, zero help finding a spot. Left soaked and annoyed.
Twelve chais and six croissants delivered mid-storm, all labelled, nothing tipped over. Zero errors.
Croissant arrived in a damp bag, layers gone soft and sad. Taste was still there under the sogginess.
Rainy evening, a warm drink, and a team that patiently explained the menu to a tourist. Welcoming little place.
Wet queue, slow counter, one person doing everything. The drink itself was fine; my morning was not.
Flat white, a book, monsoon drumming the glass, split-flap board clicking over. Small perfect afternoon.
barish ke din chai + fries aur window seat = student budget ki mini vacation. Floor bas thoda geela tha.
Rose milk took forever in the rain and the sabja had settled into a thick blob at the bottom. Okay-ish.
Ordered 15 chais for a rainy team meet, three came as lattes, one bag half-soaked. Sorting it took all evening.
Dev toned down the chilli in the arrabbiata for the kids without being asked. Thoughtful kitchen.
Usual cappuccino run in the rain. Cup double-lidded, handed over with a smile. Four minutes, door to street.
Rain crowd got loud by 11, my order took 15 minutes, and someone nicked my chair. Rough work day.
Cheesecake delivered mid-thunderstorm, glaze intact, still chilled. Whatever they pack it in is magic.
Kulhad chai while the monsoon hammered Indiranagar. Hidden-gem energy, day one of my trip.
fries ka box thoda crush ho gaya aur steam se soft ho gayi. Peri-peri dust ne bacha liya, bacche kha gaye.
290 for a cheesecake slice still makes me pause, but with rain on the window the first bite won me over.
Grabbed drinks and sandwiches for a client meeting; two items missing and the queue was chaos. Embarrassing.
Cinnamon roll slightly squashed in a damp bag but still buttery and warm-ish. Middle of the road.
Meera saw me walk in soaked and had my filter coffee going before I reached the counter. That is service.
thunder bahar, kulhad chai andar, aur koi jaldi nahi karwa raha. brew is the best monsoon adda, sach mein.
My order took 75 minutes and arrived lukewarm. Rain explains some of the delay, not all of it.
Eight lattes for a meeting, rain-delayed 40 minutes but every cup sealed and upright. Would re-order.
Dev heard the kids were cold and rushed out a waffle and hot chocolates. Stormy night turned cosy.
drink solid tha but 9 min lage counter pe, barish mein delivery pile-up tha. metro nikal gayi.
Best rainy-day office in Indiranagar: corner plug, cold brew refills, thunder for background music.
9 baje order kiya, 10:40 ko thanda aaya. Baarish hoti hai par ETA toh sach batao.
Avocado toast with chilli crunch while rain streaked the windows. Pretty plating, prettier little cafe.
Still the best counter coffee on my route, but the wet-morning queue was long and prices crept up again.
Dessert arrived in a rain-sogged sleeve, icing melted into the paper. First delivery from here, underwhelmed.
Rose latte and a window seat to watch the downpour. Slightly crowded with fellow rain-refugees, fair enough.
100 minutes for fries that arrived like wet cardboard in a collapsed box. Never again on a rainy night.
54 percent hot chocolate with marshmallows, rain lashing outside. If hygge exists in Bengaluru it lives here.
pasta arrabbiata thanda tha but spice ka kick abhi bhi tha. Baarish ka delivery tax, adjust kar liya.
monsoon crowd tha but seat mil gayi. filter coffee ka decoction strong, agli baar kulhad chai try karunga.
Food was decent but everything took 30 minutes in the wet-evening rush. Kids nearly mutinied.
Bulk order for 12 in peak rain: sandwiches labelled by name, filter coffees sealed tight, every item present. Rare reliability for a wet Friday.
Usual order ready in four minutes despite half the street sheltering inside. Rainproof efficiency.
Drinks were smooth but the storm crowd made it feel like a railway waiting room for an hour.
office ko iced latte 80 min mein aaya, ice sab melt. Barish excuse thik hai, tracking jhooth nahi.
Rainy evening, filter coffee, and a team that explained the menu patiently to a tourist. Warm place.
Shakes and fries for a rainy movie night at home. Sealed tight, arrived faster than promised. Kids thrilled.
20-minute wait and not one dry table. Standing with a plate in a crowd is not brunch.
Rain, bubbling cheddar cheese toast, corner bench. 260 rupees well spent, would do it again tomorrow.
Quality is great as always, but the rain-day takeaway line was ten deep and nobody triaged it.
thanda hua cheese toast bhi inka accha lagta hai. Rain delay tha but rider ne safe laya, thanks.
Barista moved me away from the wet entrance without me asking. Refill landed minutes later. Nice touch.
Hot chocolate cup half-empty on arrival; lid popped in the soaked bag. What survived was good. Most did not.
Food was genuinely tasty, service just drowned in the rain rush. Patience required, bring some.
Zoya pointed me to the only dry table and had my chai out in three minutes. Small cafe, big heart.
Rainy hostel night sorted: hot fries with peri-peri, delivered quicker than the app promised. Paisa vasool.
Rain soaked the outer bag, two chai lids popped, one order missing entirely. Bulk delivery gone wrong.
Croissant flaked properly even on a damp grey morning. Sat by the window and watched Indiranagar flood a little.
Order in under two minutes flat even with the monsoon queue. This counter runs like clockwork.
office lunch sandwich late aaya aur halka thanda tha, par paneer tikka filling sach mein solid thi.
Stormy workday fuelled by filter coffee refills and a paneer sandwich. Stayed till close, zero regrets.
Fifteen minutes just to order, then told the syrup I wanted was out. Rain crowd or not, tell people earlier.
Ten cappuccinos and croissants picked up mid-rain: cups named, bags stamped, nothing spilled. Clean job.
Cheesecake arrived slightly soft from the humid ride. Flavour still beautiful. Monsoon problems, I guess.
waffle aur fries dono thande aaye, ek ghanta rain mein laga. Bacche hungry aur disappointed, hum bhi.
chai aur cheese toast under 400, paisa vasool honestly. Sirf rainy-day bheed thodi zyada thi.
Team order arrived an hour late and short three drinks. Monsoon is a reason, not a business plan.
thunderstorm ke beech hot chocolate garam aaya, marshmallows intact. Dil khush ho gaya, seriously.
Rain day, packed house, my usual table taken and my regular drink a few rupees up. Off day.
Quick stop at the counter while it poured. Slower than usual but the drink itself was on point.
Rained, crowd doubled, counter chaos. Missed my train over a cappuccino and a shrug. Not okay.
Croissant stayed crisp, flat white stayed warm, mid-downpour. Genuinely do not know how they pulled it off.
Cinnamon roll survived the rainy ride, icing intact. Comfort food delivered to my door. Nice.
Coffee good, but every rain-soaked laptop in Indiranagar was in here today. Barely heard my call.
ordered matcha, regular latte aaya, wo bhi 70 min baad. Wrong item in the rain is the worst combo.
Sheltering from the rain, staff chatted and explained their chai spices. Ginger hit perfectly in this weather.
Office filter-coffee round mid-storm: all 12 arrived, all correctly sweetened. Bulk ordering works here.
Waited 14 minutes while delivery tickets hogged the counter in the rain. Lovely use of a lunch break.
Iced latte arrived with ice still rattling in this humidity. Sealed cup, careful rider. Impressive.
Drink was lovely, the packed rain-shelter crowd less so. Shoulder-to-shoulder is not cosy.
fries garam, peri-peri solid, rain mein bhi time pe aaya. 160 mein kaun complain kare.
Rainy-day regulars nodding at each other, plugs free, refills steady. Quietly dependable place.
Pasta box arrived wet-bottomed and cold; the cheese had congealed into a lump. Family dinner ruined.
Drink pulled well but the wet-morning queue cost me eight minutes I did not have. Counter needs help.
bachon ko shakes jaldi chahiye the aur team ne jhatpat bana diye. Barish wali shaam ban gayi.
office delivery late expected tha rain mein, par order 30 min mein aa gaya. Fast aur fresh.
croissant ghar pe soggy aaya, baarish ne bag bhi galaya. Aisi quality regular customer hurt karti hai.
Kabir started my usual the second I shook my umbrella off at the door. Regulars get remembered here.
Cheesecake delivered mid-storm, glaze gleaming. Wow.
usual toh mast hai but rainy morning line lambi thi aur price phir se upar. Thoda dukhi regular.
Sandwiches for a 15-person rainy-day workshop, every box labelled, zero mix-ups. Admin life made easy.
Order took 90 minutes in the rain and arrived cold, fillings wilted. The app promised 35.
Third rainy afternoon this week camping here. Cold brew consistent, nobody rushes you out. Rare.
Food was fresh and peppery, but the rain rush meant a real wait and little counter attention.
Paid nearly 300 for dessert eaten standing up, surrounded by wet umbrellas. Ambience drowned with the rain.
Sheltered from the thunder with something chilled and rosy - first time trying sabja, pleasantly weird.
